name: Open-Source Retro Handheld Max
description: A larger open-source retro handheld with dual joysticks, L1/L2/R1/R2 shoulder buttons, two TF card slots (one for the system, one for games), Type-C charging, an OTG port and a headphone jack. The 3000mAh battery gives 5 to 6 hours of play and charges in about 2 hours, per the supplier. It also plays video files. No games are included. Load your own legally owned game files.
